segments.title: Chương 9: Kỳ Thi Thử
segments.content:
Chapter 9 Placement Test

The entire morning, Jiang Nian's head was buzzing. What was going on?

A girl?

Xu Qianqian's words from that morning still echoed in his ears, "His original name on his ID is Zhou Haifei, but he never got around to changing it because the college entrance exams are coming up. Everyone usually calls him Haifei."

Damn it, Zhou Haifei is a girl!

No wonder he never confessed his feelings from high school to university. Jiang Nian thought to himself, what the hell was there to say? Was he supposed to say he was great at chemistry, because that was aluminum bronze!

But when he thought about it carefully, it was actually reasonable.

Jiang Nian knew Xu Qianqian; her orientation was definitely not an issue. Let alone someone with a successful career, even if a CEO showed up, he probably wouldn't stand a chance. That was a fact.

This system was benchmarking him against his future self from another timeline, a thirty-eight-year-old loser who was just starting over from rock bottom, competing against someone with a successful career.

Besides, the reward for this mission was so low, only 5000 yuan.

During the long break after the second period.

Jiang Nian wandered around outside Xu Qianqian's classroom for a bit, and seeing no teacher, he walked right in. Generally, students weren't allowed to visit other classes, but thick-skinned people were an exception.

After all, Xu Qianqian's grades were among the top in the Olympiad class, and she was a beauty. No class monitor would suddenly lose their mind and jump out, shouting that outsiders weren't allowed.

"Hey, Qianqian, your childhood playmate is here."

"Get lost!"

The female students who were close to Xu Qianqian joked around, and a wave of playful laughter erupted. This was a common interaction among high school girls, pointing at a boy and saying, "Your husband, your husband."

But this wasn't a teen idol drama. No one would be stupid enough to say something like "the school stud." Being called someone's "husband" was often not much of a compliment.

Xu Qianqian blushed and slapped her deskmate.

"Don't talk nonsense."

Jiang Nian, however, looked unconcerned. He walked straight into the aisle. He first struck up a conversation with Xu Qianqian's deskmate, making the girl beam with just a few sentences.

One of the perks of being a social butterfly was being good with people.

But it was of little real use. Aside from Xu Qianqian's deskmate, no one else cared about this boy from a parallel class.

It wasn't that they looked down on him; the reality was that in school, everything was about grades, or else family background. Being exceptional in either one was enough to be very popular.

"What are you here for?"

"Oh, right, to ask about a math problem, this one." Jiang Nian wrote the problem on her scratch paper. When you were bad at math, you were truly bad, so all you could do was ask for help.

Xu Qianqian tucked her hair behind her ear and leaned over to take a look.

"Oh, for this one, you use..."

Her deskmate, Song Xiyun, had sparkling eyes, darting back and forth between the clean and handsome Jiang Nian and Xu Qianqian, the corners of her mouth unconsciously curling upwards.

After he was done, Jiang Nian asked one more thing.

"Which one is Zhou Haifei?"

Xu Qianqian's brow furrowed imperceptibly, but she still told him in a low voice.

"The one in the third row, fifth seat, by the wall. The one with glasses. Don't stare directly at a girl, Jiang Nian, are you a pig?"

Jiang Nian only glanced over. A girl with glasses on the inner side of the classroom, looking thin. She had her head down doing her work, her hair covering half her face, making it hard to see clearly.

As if by some stroke of insight, the girl with glasses also looked up in his direction. Her eyes met Jiang Nian's for a split second, revealing an ordinary face, before she nonchalantly lowered her head again.

After Jiang Nian left.

Song Xiyun poked her deskmate's waist. "Hey, Qianqian, did you two really grow up together?"

"I guess so."

"I heard that when Li Bai married his childhood sweetheart, he didn't even look back when they entered the bridal chamber. He was probably too embarrassed." Song Xiyun chattered on, making Xu Qianqian's face turn red.

"What are you talking about!" "Li Bai." Song Xiyun said with an innocent face, a smile playing in her eyes. "What's wrong? Who did you think I was talking about? Don't tell me it's you..."

"You're dead, Song Xiyun!"

Jiang Nian returned to his classroom. For now, he had no good ideas for the system's mission. The girl hadn't even spoken to Xu Qianqian, so what could he do?

The most direct method would be to make it appear that Xu Qianqian was already taken, but visible only to one person (Zhou Haifei).

But that was just something he could think about, commonly known as a fantasy.

He decided to wait and see for now.

For three straight days, Jiang Nian was busy catching up on math.

The first monthly exam of senior year, commonly known as the senior year placement test, was tomorrow. Compared to the system's 5000 yuan, this was clearly more important.

He didn't want to stay in this class anymore. The first placement test came with the authority to switch classes. The top students from the lower-tier classes and the bottom students from the higher-tier classes would swap places; this was the unwritten rule.

As for why he wasn't studying for physics, let's just say, if the person writing the physics exam was feeling a little malicious, the class could end up with a bunch of geniuses scoring in the single digits.

His physics score wasn't terrible, around a 60, so there was no need to waste time on it.

"Jiang Nian, why have you started studying?" Le Zhi sauntered over with a flashy air, sitting in front of him with a sleazy smile. "What rattled you?"

Jiang Nian looked up, wondering what to say. He couldn't just say he wanted to get away from a bunch of losers like them.

"Oh, it's nothing, just studying for fun."

"Tough talk. This is a classic symptom of post-breakup trauma." Le Zhi was as thin as a bamboo pole, and his raspy voice sounded like Tianxia Wuzei from Go-Bo-Go. "You're still thinking about that incident?"

Jiang Nian smiled, asking what incident he was talking about, while thinking to himself, screw all of your mothers.

"Everyone was just joking around. Find a chance to talk it out and it'll be fine." Le Zhi crossed his legs and said with a grin, "It feels weird without you."

"How about this, the day after tomorrow, after the monthly exam, Zhou Yuting said she wants to get barbecue in the evening. You wanna come?"

Jiang Nian didn't even raise his head. "Not going."

Le Zhi, having been rebuffed, left directly.

Jiang Nian sat at his desk, gripping the pen in his hand tightly. He suddenly recalled things from the past and felt like a complete idiot. How could he have ever hung out with this group of people?

Ultimately, this group of people only got together to show off, judging others wantonly one moment.

If they were in a bad mood, the next moment, if someone kindly asked them what was wrong, they would immediately put on a cold, idiotic face.

This group even praised this kind of sudden cold-faced personality, thinking they were cool for being fawned over. They carried a sense of superiority, just a bunch of snobs.

In the end, they were just idiots, and hanging out with people like them would sooner or later turn him into an idiot too.

Taking a deep breath, Jiang Nian continued to study.

The next day, the day of the placement test arrived.

The first-year seniors had the weekend off, so their academic building was used as the examination site for the third-year seniors. As class assignments were at stake, the school took this very seriously, and the invigilation was unprecedentedly strict.

Jiang Nian carried his pencil case and found his exam hall in advance.

The exam arrangement completely followed the college entrance exam format. The first subject was Chinese, and the seats in the exam hall were spaced far apart. The person at the desk in front of him was a quiet girl in a summer uniform, her arms fair.

When passing the exam paper, the girl turned around. She had a pretty face with gentle eyes, and she wore jeans with the white summer school uniform, which made her skin look very fair.

When she passed back the answer sheet, the bangs on both sides of her cheeks, shaped like the tips of calligraphy brushes, hung down, as if about to split the stuffy summer with a cool, artistic style.

(End of this chapter)
